rules.text: 0-1 Chaos Warmaster of Khorne

rules.key: must be taken in fleets of 750 points or more
rules.text: A Chaos Warmaster (and their required capital ship) must be taken in fleets of 750 points or more.
rules.why: The book's wording is 'in fleets of 750 points or more', not 'worth ... or more'. MAND_GE was widened on 7.9.2026, and at the same time the guard was changed: it now compares the sentence's words with the SECTION's heading and does not look for a word referring to leading. Without the change this rule was missing from five lists.

rules.key: You can only include a Chaos Warmaster in your fleet if it includes any capital ships
rules.text: You can only include a Chaos Warmaster in your fleet if it includes any capital ships.
rules.why: The condition depends on whether the fleet has hull ships; the engine has no conditional commander limits.

rules.key: Any capital ship can be designated as having
rules.text: Any capital ship can be designated as having a World Eaters Chaos Space Marine crew at +35 points.
rules.why: A priced option; the row can be chosen.

rules.key: battleships and grand cruisers with Chaos Space Marine
rules.text: For +10 points, battleships and grand cruisers with Chaos Space Marine Warmasters, Lords or crews may include Chosen Terminators.
rules.why: A priced option whose condition concerns the ship's type and crew.

rules.key: A fleet of 1,000 points or more may include the Planet Killer
rules.text: A fleet of 1,000 points or more may include the Planet Killer.
rules.why: Enforced 9.9.2026 (item 8): the rule read from the book was added to build_data.py's RULE_PICKS table; resolveFleet checks it. allowed_at: the Planet Killer is allowed only from the 1000 point limit. The earlier gap: a PERMISSION tied to a points limit, not a requirement. The same missing rule type as for the Space Marines' Fortress-Monastery and the Inquisition's Inquisitor Lord.

rules.key: 0-1 Planet Killer
rules.text: 0-1 Planet Killer

rules.key: You may include up to one Space Hulk in the fleet, which must be the flagship
rules.text: You may include up to one Space Hulk in the fleet, which must be the flagship if chosen.
rules.why: The book writes this limit twice: as a heading and as a sentence. The app showed two identical rows of them until they were merged on 7.9.2026. One check is left, whose source sentence is the book's full sentence. Fixed 14.9.2026: the sentence had been copied from another Chaos list ('See its profile for restrictions and how to include it'), and p.251 does not say so - it requires the ship as the flagship. Found with check_quotes.py.

rules.key: Bezerker Fleets led by a Space Hulk may have more than two battleships
rules.text: Bezerker Fleets led by a Space Hulk may have more than two battleships, but other restrictions remain unchanged.
rules.why: An exception to the number of battleships, conditioned on the fleet's leader. The app shows the sentence in the Chaos Space Hulk section (the golden khorne-chaos-hulk-more-battleships requires it on the card), but does not enforce it. The row was missing entirely until 14.9.2026, because the list's Space Hulk sentence had been copied from another Chaos list.

rules.key: one battleship in your fleet for every three cruisers or heavy cruisers
rules.text: You may include up to one battleship in your fleet for every three cruisers or heavy cruisers.
rules.why: The denominator covers both types only after 7.9.2026; before that 'or heavy cruisers' was cut off and the check was too strict.

rules.key: one grand cruiser in your fleet for every three cruisers or heavy cruisers
rules.text: You may include up to one grand cruiser in your fleet for every three cruisers or heavy cruisers.

rules.key: one heavy cruiser in your fleet for every two cruisers
rules.text: You may include up to one heavy cruiser in your fleet for every two cruisers.

rules.key: escorts in your fleet in squadrons of 2
rules.text: You may include any number of escorts in your fleet in squadrons of 2-6 unless specified (see pg. 13).

rules.key: Ships with launch bays can have a mixture
rules.text: Ships with launch bays can have a mixture of Swiftdeath fighters, Doomfire bombers and Dreadclaw assault craft. Ships with torpedo tubes are armed with normal and boarding torpedoes.
rules.why: The book's sentence shows as the section's text. The ordnance type is chosen during the game, so there is nothing to enforce. (Earlier 'not_shown': RULEY did not know the word 'can', fixed 7.9.2026.)

rules.key: Up to a quarter of the capital ships (not battleships or the flagship)
rules.text: Up to a quarter of the capital ships (not battleships or the flagship) in a Berzerker Fleet may be upgraded to Daemonships at the additional points cost shown, based upon the type of vessel chosen.
rules.why: The sentence shows; the share is not enforced, because the flagship is not modelled. The player's responsibility.

rules.key: A Daemonship may not be commanded by a Warmaster or a Chaos Lord
rules.text: A Daemonship may not be commanded by a Warmaster or a Chaos Lord, even if it is the largest ship in the fleet ... A Daemonship may not have a Chaos Space Marine crew.
rules.why: The app does not tie a commander to a single ship, so the ban cannot be enforced.

rules.key: may not have a Chaos Space Marine crew
rules.text: A Daemonship may not be commanded by a Warmaster or a Chaos Lord, even if it is the largest ship in the fleet ... A Daemonship may not have a Chaos Space Marine crew.
rules.why: Two upgrades that exclude each other. Both are list rows, but the exclusion is left to the player: they are in different sections and do not share a group.

rules.key: A fleet 1,000 points or more may include the Slaverer
rules.text: A fleet 1,000 points or more may include the Slaverer as one of its battleships, subject to normal restrictions.
rules.why: Enforced 10.9.2026 (fleet spot check, report 17): the sentence was plain text, made a rule in build_data.py's RULE_PICKS table; resolveFleet checks it (allowed_at).

rules.key: one cruiser from any Imperial Navy fleet list up to 185 points
rules.text: For every 1,500 points in a Chaos fleet, one cruiser from any Imperial Navy fleet list up to 185 points and/or up to six Imperial Navy escorts may be taken. Special weapon rules, Nova Cannon, Chaos Lords, Chaos Space Marines, Chaos ordnance or Daemonship upgrades may not be taken for Imperial Navy vessels used in this manner, and cruisers suffer -1Ld for going renegade. Imperial Navy escorts need not be in a single squadron and may be interspersed within other Chaos escort squadrons if desired. These vessels may not take any upgrade listed in their profile and do not count as reserves; they count as Chaos vessels in all respects.
rules.why: 1.1 (14.9.2026): a section of its own RENEGADE IMPERIAL VESSELS with Imperial hulls (cruisers at most 185 p and escorts) without profile upgrades (noopt). Two per_points rules: one cruiser and six escorts per FULL 1500 points (the sentence does not say 'or part thereof'). The end of the sentence 'they count as Chaos vessels in all respects' holds because the list's own 0-12 Cruisers and the escort squadron rule count these in (section_count.pick). Page 232 does not fit in the lists' rule window (lists.py rules_pages, six pages), so the section's text carries the sentence to the player.

rules.key: Abaddon can be chosen to act as fleet commander in any game in which the Chaos fleet is worth 1,000 points or more
rules.text: Abaddon can be chosen to act as fleet commander in any game in which the Chaos fleet is worth 1,000 points or more.
rules.why: The user's decision 13.10.2026 (BACKLOG J162): Abaddon's general rule p.241 concerns any Chaos fleet. The list's Fleet Commander section does not list him, but the list's own Planet Killer row (p.251: 'If Abaddon is present, he must be aboard the Planet Killer') and the god's barge profile allow for him. The same sentence carries the limit Warmaster or Abaddon (cap 1), and the required Warmaster is met by him. The row is a copy of the Black Crusade's row.

entries.name: Slaverer
entries.why: The book writes the row in the form '0-1 Name' WITHOUT brackets. The parser knew only the form '(0-1) Name', so '0-1' stayed part of the name and the count limit went unenforced. Fixed 7.9.2026; concerned nine rows in five lists.

notes: The frame is the same as in the Chaos Incursion down to the three ratios and the 0-12 cruisers, but the Space Hulk is NOT the same: p.251 requires it as the flagship and allows a fleet it leads more than two battleships. An earlier note claimed the lists were the same, and exactly that error moved the Incursion's sentence here.
The daemonship price list is a table of its own in the book; the app offers the rows 'Battleship / Grand cruiser / Heavy cruiser / Cruiser' in its own DAEMONSHIPS section.

The DAEMON SHIPS price list is printed in the book as ship classes only, because the section heading tells what is bought: 'Battleship +50 / Grand cruiser +30 / Heavy cruiser +25 / Cruiser +20'. In the app the row showed until 7.9.2026 under the name 'Grand Cruiser +50', which tells nothing - and because the section has no ships, the rows were offered to EVERY ship. A grand cruiser was thus offered three different prices at once. Now the row is 'Daemonship: <class>' and attached to the section whose heading is the same class in the plural.
13.10.2026 (J162): Abaddon added by the user's decision on the basis of p.241's general rule; the price 195 is printed only in the Black Crusade list (p.244).
